envelope: Keep all existing first-web, cap, nails and CMC-cage fields frozen.
Where tissue identity is verified as shared web/base, thumb-base influence follows adjacency and regional role, decaying toward independent index tube and toward wrist on palm anchors.
The 10–16-edge remote exact collar is outside this locally evidenced envelope until its body-side tissue identity and anatomical correspondence are reviewed.
Maintain an INDEX_MCP deformation degree of freedom on index-root tissue; never bind the entire collar to thumb groups.
Each collar pair needs dynamically compatible local deformation; do not impose identical vectors solely from digit ownership.
No numerical percentages or per-vertex assignments are approved; sensitivity fractions have no authority.
